channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Chicagoans, Local Leaders Say ICE ‘Must Be Abolished’ After Killing Of Minneapolis Nurse Alex Pretti
item.description: A series of protests in Chicago followed Pretti's fatal shooting. Gov. JB Pritzker and Mayor Brandon Johnson called for ICE to be abolished.

item.title: Lake Effect Snow Pummels Chicago As Dangerous Cold Expected To Linger
item.description: Lakefront areas could see as much as a foot of snow Sunday while the brutal cold spell will continue through early this week, according to the National Weather Service.

item.title: Boka Group’s New Spot, Famed Japanese Ramen Shop Coming And More Downtown Dining News
item.description: From a butcher-backed sandwich shop in the Loop to a masa-focused Mexican restaurant in Fulton Market, here’s what’s opening soon.

item.title: Argyle Lunar New Year Parade Returns Next Month Celebrating Year Of The Horse
item.description: Local groups will host cultural performances and neighbors can win prizes and gift cards with traditional lucky red envelopes.

item.title: Sarah’s Circle Bringing More Women’s Housing To Uptown, Other Far North Side Development News
item.description: A former Edgewater church will soon become 32 apartments, and a five-story building is coming to an Uptown parking lot.

item.title: Beverly’s Pike House To Be Restored Thanks To County Partnership
item.description: The agreement approved by Cook County will enable the Eugene S. Pike House Foundation to access a $1.5 million state grant and begin work on the late 19th-century home.

item.title: Teatro ZinZanni Dinner Theater Closing Due To Low Ticket Sales
item.description: The show ends its seven-year Chicago run Saturday. While the decision to close was “a shock,” founder Norman Langill said he hopes to return in the fall.

item.title: Meet The Runners Who Refuse To Let Chicago’s Arctic Chill Slow Them Down
item.description: Some Chicagoans training for their next race see subzero temps as a challenge worth facing — with triple layers and trail running shoes on. "We're crazy, man," one said.

item.title: Your Favorite Restaurant’s Playlist Was Probably Made By This Chicago Company
item.description: Uncanned Music has carved out a niche curating music and installing reel-to-reel-players for top restaurants in Chicago and across the country.

item.title: 6 Chicago-Area Catholic Schools To Close This Spring, Archdiocese Says
item.description: St. Francis Borgia in Dunning, Sts. Bruno and Richard School in Archer Heights, St. Jerome School in Bridgeport, St. Stanislaus Kostka in Wicker Park and two suburban schools are on the closure list due to low enrollment.
